name: Review Request for WooCommerce
author: wpreviewpro

sections.description:
Review Request for WooCommerce lets you send review request emails to WooCommerce customers directly from the order page.

Collect more customer reviews, increase trust, and improve conversions with simple, one-click review requests.

Unlike complex review platforms, this plugin is lightweight, fast, and works directly inside your WooCommerce dashboard.

Key Features

✔ Send review request emails directly from WooCommerce orders
✔ One-click “Send Review Request” button
✔ Lightweight and easy to use (no bloat)
✔ Works inside the WooCommerce order admin
✔ No external platform required

Why Use This Plugin?

Customer reviews are essential for building trust and increasing sales.

This plugin makes it easy to ask customers for feedback right after their purchase — without complicated setups or expensive tools.

Perfect for store owners who want a simple and effective way to collect reviews.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Orders
  3. Click “Send Review Request”
  4. The customer receives an email asking for a review

External Services

This plugin connects to the Google Places API to retrieve business rating and review data.

  • Service: Google LLC
  • Data sent: Place ID and API key
  • Usage: Fetching Google reviews and ratings

Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Donate Link

https://wpreviewpro.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I customize the email?

This version provides a default email template.

Does this plugin use external services?

Yes, it uses the Google Places API to retrieve review and rating data.
